title: EntityDetailsScreen
responsibility: The details screen of an entity of any kind: contract, measurements, and the source only when it is asked for.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.index
inputs.description: The prepared history index of the selected repository; this screen reads only its optional sourceRepository. The source tab links files to GitHub only when that value is an https://github.com/owner/name URL, and otherwise shows no GitHub link.

revisions.subject: Show the measurements tab of entity details
revisions.author: Example Author

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.head
inputs.description: The selected revision, which every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to. The screen reads its registry to find the entity, its valid records of the same commit to choose the verdict record, and its regressions, sourceTree and side to collect measurements; without a registry, the frame states that instead.

units.title: Evidence grid
units.responsibility: Filters report media and coordinates screenshot and paired-audio viewers.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of the selected commit, which the host reads only when the address names a commit and the index holds that parent; it is null for a branch-tip address, a first commit, a parent the index does not hold, or a parent that failed to load. The frame reads it only to show a unit that the selected commit removed, as that unit last was at the parent's commit.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.scope
inputs.description: The resolved place of the address in history: its branch, its mode ('current' when the address names no commit, 'commit' otherwise), and the commit every contract, measurement and capture is bound to. The screen reads commit for an entity without lastAt and for the short commit in not-found messages, and mode for the frame's data-mode attribute.

summary.subject: Show the measurements tab of entity details
summary.author: Example Author

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.route
inputs.description: The address shown, the same as scope.location: branch, commit (null when the address follows the branch tip), category, and the entity, helper and tab it names. The screen passes route.tab to the entity details, and the frame reads route.entity, route.helper and route.category to find the entity and link back to its collection.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.entities
inputs.description: The entities the explorer lists at head: its active units in explorer order, plus the units the selected commit removed when the parent is read. The frame looks the shown entity up here by id equal to route.entity before it searches head.registry.units.

examples.name: EvidenceGrid
examples.purpose: Filters report media and coordinates screenshot and paired-audio viewers.

unit.title: Evidence grid
unit.responsibility: Filters report media and coordinates screenshot and paired-audio viewers.

verdict.label: Evidence missing
reasons: No verification record is attached to this commit.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.lens
inputs.description: The host's answers about entities: relations(id) for an entity's relations, evidence(unit) for a component's captures, and href(to) for the address of a location. The screen calls relations for owner and helper checks and evidence for component screens, and the frame passes href to navigation.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.client
inputs.description: A stored-revision reader supplied by the host. This screen and its frame never call it: the host reads the head and parent with it, and the history screen reads the commits its history lists.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: The URL prefix that retained recorded evidence media is read from; the host sets it to its base plus '/media/'. The screen passes it to the component's EntityScreens and to the source dialog, which fetches each archived file at this prefix followed by the file name after 'media/'.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.onroute
inputs.description: The host's navigation callback, which the frame passes on as nav.go so that links in the screen request their destinations through it. This screen never changes the address itself.

outputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.entityDetails
outputs.description: The details of the selected entity inside the entity frame: the contract with its size and performance by default, the measurements on the measurements tab, and the source files on the source tab. When head has no registry the frame says 'No registry at this revision' instead, and when the entity is not held there it says 'Not at this revision' with a link back to its collection.

errors.name: source-not-archived
errors.description: Reading a source file for the source dialog rejects when the first recorded entry for that path, looked up in source files and then in test files, has no media at this revision; the message is that entry's gap, or '<path> is not archived at this revision.' when it has none.

errors.name: source-reference-invalid
errors.description: Reading a source file for the source dialog rejects when its recorded media reference is not 'media/' followed by 64 lowercase hex characters and '.txt'; the message is 'The recorded source reference is invalid.'

errors.name: source-read-failed
errors.description: Reading a source file for the source dialog rejects when fetching its archived media returns a response that is not OK; the message names the path and the HTTP status.
